title: Measuring and Improving BERT's Mathematical Abilities by Predicting the Order of Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Permutation consistency test where multiple-choice answer options are randomly shuffled to determine if the model's predictions rely on the order of the answers rather than the content.

Qualitative analysis of prediction patterns to identify model reliance on superficial characteristics of answer options, such as a preference for round numbers, numbers ending in zeros, or unique formats (e.g., floats versus integers).
